Top Plays This Week From the data

Prioritised from seller revenue, trend and ad-product gaps.
1

Re-price the flat-fee giants

Mouser and DigiKey received 6.5M billable clicks in 365D on $370K/month of flat fees: about $0.87 and $0.52 per click, against $2.15 and $2.41 average CPC before Aug 2025.

Q03 + Q12 + Q45 ↗
2

Sell Boost to TTI

TTI earned $1.02M billed CPC on 538K clicks in 365D with no Boost and Boost not enabled. Similar gaps: LCSC, Zoro, Rochester, Analog Devices.

Q03 ↗
3

Protect Arrow and Verical

90-day revenue fell 17% (Arrow) and 18% (Verical) against the prior 90 days.

Q03 ↗
4

Win back Texas Instruments

TI billed $511K in the prior year and $2K in the last 365D; its billable clicks fell from 19.6K in Jun 2025 to under 1K a month.

Q05 + Q45 ↗

Recommended Talk Tracks

Talking points tied to each account’s own numbers.
B

Boost upsell · TTI

You received 538K billable clicks from Octopart buyers in the last year, with no Boost. Peers like Future Electronics run 55 Boosts.

Q03 + Q14 + Q01 ↗
T

TLA upsell · Verical

You run 28 Boosts but no Top Line Ad. Top Line Ads served 104.92M impressions in the last 365D.

Q03 + Q22 ↗
F

Flat-fee renewal · Mouser

3.02M billable clicks in 365D on a $220K monthly fee is about $0.87 per click, against $2.15 average CPC before Aug 2025.

Q03 + Q12 + Q45 ↗
W

Win-back · Texas Instruments

Billed $511K in the year to Oct 2025 and $2K since. Buyers still want TI parts: TI-made parts drew 780K billable clicks in the last 365D, nearly all through other sellers.

Q05 + Q07 + Q03 ↗

Why Is BOM 2.0 Behind? From the data

!

Most BOMs are anonymous

83% of creations come from people who are not signed in, and only 158 anonymous creations were followed by a new account.

Q35 + Q37 ↗
!

Paid media buys low-intent volume

BOM v2 campaigns delivered 326.56M impressions and 3.66M clicks in 365D for 41,457 BOM creations.

Q21 + Q22 ↗
!

One-and-done usage

74% of signed-in creators built only one BOM; the top 10% built 38.5% of signed-in BOMs.

Q35 ↗
+

Export is the hook

24,094 Excel exports; 3,262 signed-in users used the main export. Every export needs an account.

Risks, Opportunities & Actions

What the Snowflake data says, ranked. Every statement links to the query it came from.

Risks

!

Billed CPC revenue down 19.7% year on year

$31.12M in the last 365D vs $38.75M. Mouser and DigiKey billed $15.0M in the prior year; since Aug 2025 their clicks bill (near) $0 and they pay flat fees worth $4.4M a year.

Q01 + Q03 + Q12 + Q45 ↗
!

Paid search return fell from 2.2× to 0.8×

Google Ads spend rose 32% while paid-search sessions fell 41% and their billed CPC revenue halved.

Q19 + Q18 ↗
!

New accounts rarely come back

D7 retention is 5.0% for Q2 2026 sign-ups against 17.6% a year earlier, and new offer-clickers stayed flat while registrations tripled.

Q29 + Q30 ↗
!

Almost no marketing consent

668 of 232,855 accounts created in the last 365D opted in to the newsletter (0.3%).

Q26 ↗
!

Revenue depends on ten sellers

The top 10 sellers produce 54.5% of billed CPC revenue; 72 sellers that billed last year billed nothing in the last 90 days.

Q04 ↗
!

No live pipeline in Snowflake

Pardot opportunities stopped syncing in Jul 2025, so bookings, renewals and pipeline cannot be tracked here.

Q42 ↗

Opportunities

+

Boost is growing fast

Boost premium reached $5.69M in 365D, up 39%, but only 47 of 262 sellers with billable clicks run one.

Q01 + Q14 ↗
+

Signed-in buyers are worth more each year

Signed-in users drove 9.1% of billed revenue in the last 365D, up from 4.6%.

Q01 ↗
+

Referral traffic tripled and pays best

Referral sessions rose from 1.22M to 3.57M and earn $1.55 billed revenue per session, the highest of any channel.

Q18 ↗
+

Microcontroller demand spiked

Microcontroller category searches went from 1.7K to 282K in 90 days: a category to sell Boost and Top Line Ads against.

Q25 ↗
+

Fast-growing manufacturers to pitch

Billable clicks on Nexperia parts rose 107% and Diodes Inc. 53% year on year.

Q07 ↗
+

Top Line Ad reach doubled

Top Line Ad impressions: 16.1M in the last 30D vs 7.3M in the 30D before.

Q22 ↗

Actions This Week

1

Re-price flat-fee contracts

Take effective cost per click ($0.87 Mouser, $0.52 DigiKey) into renewal discussions.

Owner: Sales · Q03 + Q12 ↗
2

Hand sales the Boost upsell list

TTI, LCSC, Zoro, Rochester, Analog Devices, Quest and others bill over $150K a year with no Boost.

Owner: Sales + PMM · Q03 ↗
3

Restore the consent checkbox

Opt-in fell from 9.4% to 0.3% when sign-up moved to Altium ID.

Owner: Product · Q27 + Q26 ↗
4

Audit paid search

Dynamic search ads take 67% of Google Ads spend; check them against billed revenue per session.

Owner: Marketing · Q21 ↗
5

Reconnect Salesforce/Pardot to Snowflake

Fills the blank pipeline, renewal and bookings cards on this page.

Owner: Data · Q42 ↗
6

Fix tracking gaps

Device type is empty on searches, CAD download events are inconsistent and login-modal events stopped in 2025.

Owner: Product analytics · Q23 ↗
